column1: # Non-git host state on THIS installation. Hard Floor 5 (instructions/reproducible-from-git.md)
# requires host state that must not be in git to be enumerated instead -- "not in git is never
# allowed to mean not written down". This file is that enumeration; instance/host-state.md is its
# narrative, and tools/check-host-state.ts is the mechanism that keeps it from going stale.
# path       a template: $HOME, $XDG_*_HOME and $INSTALL_ROOT are resolved at probe time.
# writer     tracked file(s) that name this path, or external:<what writes it> when nothing
#            tracked spells it literally. Tracked writers are re-checked against the source.
# disposition must-survive | rebuildable | ephemeral | secret | off-host | orphan
# verify     the exact command. It is what `--verify` runs; there is no second version of it.
# NO SECRET VALUE APPEARS HERE. Credentials are named by location and checked by secret-file /
# secret-dir probes, which stat and never open. Their content is V3-2.10's row, not this one.
